newsitem.title: USA: Disney producer Bruckheimer extends contract.
newsitem.headline: Disney producer Bruckheimer extends contract.

text.p: Walt Disney Co said Friday that producer Jerry Bruckheimer, whose films have earned nearly $2 billion at the U.S. box office, has extended his production deal with Disney Motion Pictures Group for another five years.

Under terms of the deal, the producer and his Jerry Bruckheimer Films unit will maintain offices at Walt Disney Studios and in Santa Monica, Calif., where he will produce motion picture entertainment for the studio's various production banners, the company said.
This new deal extends and adjusted the studio's original long-term arrangement with Bruckheimer and his late partner, Don Simpson, which was first announced in 1991, it said.

Bruckheimer, along with his partner Simpson, produced films such as "Flashdance," "Beverly Hills Cop," "Top Gun," "Days of Thunder," "Bad Boys," "Dangerous Minds," "Crimson Tide" and "The Rock," Disney said.
